title: [Mac] MOSS-Image SFT Seedhunt Workflow [Workflows/MOSS Image]
description:
Seed hunting workflow for MOSS-Image SFT on Mac. Native nodes only, no custom packs.

What it does well:

  • Legible text in scene, English and Chinese. Signs, menus, posters, neon, multi-line.

  • Long prompts, photoreal skin, phone selfies, older faces, anime.

Settings I settled on:

  • 25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde, simple. Official 50/cfg 3 gave same sharpness at double the time.

  • Negative prompt barely matters at cfg 2.5.

  • SLG (layer 22): +50% time, no visible gain. Off.

  • Prompt enhancer: ~15 min per prompt on Mac, no gain. Off.

  • 8-step LoRA makes skin waxy (sharpness 3-10x lower). Kept as turbo_lora_hunt_mode for scanning comps at ~50 s, then re-render the pick with it off at the same seed.

Prompting: write a caption of the finished image. Visible text in quotes with position. No camera talk, no quality words, the model renders those literally.
